name: PT Bekasi Fajar Industrial Estate Tbk
summary: PT Bekasi Fajar Industrial Estate Tbk develops and operates industrial estates in Indonesia. It operates through Industrial Estate and Other segments. The company provides industrial estate land; offers and maintains supporting infrastructure and facilities; and develops supporting facilities, such as coffee shops, restaurants, hotels, and others. It also engages in the development of hotels and facilities. PT Bekasi Fajar Industrial Estate Tbk was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Bekasi, Indonesia.
